cohort: 237 women delivered by cesarean section (94 healthy pregnancies, 87 preeclampsia, 39 pregestational and gestational diabetes mellitus, 17 diabetes mellitus with preeclampsia)
finding: Uteroplacental acute atherosis (AA) in older women was associated with elevated levels of LDL and apolipoprotein B, indicating a link between AA and dyslipidemia, a cardiovascular risk factor.
